headline: Healthy Q2, Ceramics leads the charge

highlights: Change in Estimates Current Previous FY28E FY29E FY28E FY29E Rating Accumulate Hold Target Price 1,178 1,072 Sales (INR mn) 61,949 69,270 61,273 68,483 % Chng. 1.1 1.1 EBITDA (INR mn) 9,354 10,806 9,375 10,820 % Chng.
Ceramics remains the key growth driver, supported by strong traction in industrial engineered ceramics, metallized cylinders and Bloom Energy-related products, alongside improving product mix.

However, Abrasives profitability remains under pressure from elevated phenolic resin and fuel costs, with limited pricing pass-through; management expects margins to have bottomed out, with gradual recovery towards the normalised 15-16% range as cost pressures ease and price increases are implemented.
Electro Minerals margins are expected to remain relatively stable, supported by favourable product mix and geographic diversification.

The stock is trading at a P/E of 40.6x/34.9x on FY28E/29E earnings.
The business is targeting breakeven by Q1FY28, followed by a gradual improvement in profitability, supported by a restructuring and operational improvement programme.
